team_members: Long Nguyen, Tiffanie Nguyen, Quynh Thi Kim Do
comment: Narration: AI-generated voice (Google Gemini). Picture: screen recording of the live page.
notice_sentence: NASA plans to begin shutting down Terra and Aqua in late 2026 or early 2027 and encourages users to move to VIIRS.
notice_source: NASA Earthdata notice “Transition from MODIS to VIIRS”, 2 May 2025, as cited on the page
captions: We're team Kahu Ahi, from Maui.
NASA is retiring MODIS, its fire record since 2000.
VIIRS takes over, but sees over six times as many hot spots.
Kahu Ahi corrects VIIRS month by month with NASA data: about ten percent error on years it never saw.
Thirty-seven of forty-nine pass the test. Where it fails, it says so.
Every detection has its place, its time, and NASA's image of that day.
When MODIS ends, the record continues.
